paragraph: East Rutherford is a small market, and the numbers reflect that. Nine single-family sales over six months at a median of $750,000, mostly three-bedroom colonials and bi-levels with two baths. Sale prices ran from $330,000 to $1,400,000, so the median is the number to anchor on. Slightly more than half sold above list with a sale-to-list ratio right at 1.00 and a median of 18 days on market. That is competitive but not frenzied. Well-priced homes move quickly here, and you should expect competition on the good ones. Two-families are the higher-priced tier, with four sales at a median of $959,500, all of them above asking and a median of 14 days on market. Four sales is a thin sample, but the demand for income property in this part of Bergen County is real. Condos and townhouses came in at five sales with a median of $555,000, typically two bedrooms and two baths, and a median of 27 days on market. Monthly closings never got above three in any single month, so there is no readable monthly trend here. Judge East Rutherford on the six-month picture, not month to month. If you're comparing tiers, the deciding factor isn't market heat. It's whether you want the space and grounds of a single-family, the rental income of a two-family, or the low-maintenance lifestyle of a condo.
